notes:
## Flex Mechs and Item Swapper reliability

- Flex Mechs is now ready whenever Rocket League is running, regardless of which window is focused.
- Added a clear Horse Dash activation warning for Casual and Ranked use while keeping Training, Private Match, and LAN use available.
- Improved Horse Dash timing so long sequences no longer accumulate execution drift or fail after several seconds.
- Brief controller polling gaps no longer interrupt an active Horse Dash.
- Item swaps can now be applied, activated, deactivated, reverted, and removed while Rocket League is running, including automatic retries during short package-file locks.
